notes.title: New BL Visual Novel!
notes.content:
PIRATES!!

In the mood for playing a short visual novel with pirates and BL romance? Then, as usual, Ertal Games is here to provide the experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/f39a1d55e13789dbae58fe39960b7a94973592db.png

Jolly Roger is a visual novel developed for the Yaoi Jam (hence its short length), with only one love interest but four possible endings. And it's now available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2383620/Con_cien_caones_por_banda/

Check it out! ;)

notes.title: Our new game is out!
notes.content:
Great news! Our more recent BL Visual Novel, Lurkers, was released yesterday!

Lurkers is a short thriller revolving around the Jack the Ripper crimes. It features around 35k words, two suspects, three love interests, one bad ending if you choose the wrong culprit, and one good ending plus additional conclusions with the love interest of your choice, or a solo/friendship conclusion if you prefer. The rating is 15+.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/2eaf8fc900cc69941dd478171fc65a9be9d00489.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/

Come and have a taste of the grimmest side of Victorian England!
